The '''''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle''' was a vessel used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RepublicShuttle2-NGO.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The dual engines of the Republic shuttle.]]
A smaller version of the [[NR2 gully jumper]], the ''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle was a long-range shuttle used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was similar in appearance to the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] in use thousands of years later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It had a roughly inverted "V" shape with two downward sloping wings that would fold upwards when in landing configuration.<ref name="NGO" /> Its propulsion system consisted of two drive engines and it was armed with at least two forward-mounted laser cannons.<ref name="NGO" />

==History==
The ''[[Lucky Lancer]]'' was a ''Rendaran''-class that was widely celebrated for having survived over one hundred combat missions throughout the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Lucky Lancer">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Lucky Lancer (Trooper)}}</ref>

After the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]] were dispatched on a diplomatic mission to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. They used a ''Rendaran''-class shuttle for their voyage and while en route, stumbled upon a drifting escape pod with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] and the droid [[SP-99]] on board. A ship of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] raiders was bearing down on the pod at the same time, but the shuttle was able to salvage the escape pod first, and destroy the much larger battleship.<ref name="NGO" />
